subject.title: feat: configure metadata (contextWindow, maxTokens, etc.) for custom provider setup

question: After the metadata-preservation defects are fixed, should OpenClaw accept a configure-time custom-provider metadata editor, or should model metadata setup be unified across configure, onboard, and non-interactive flows first?
rationale: The concrete source defects are mechanically repairable, but adding a new setup prompt for persisted provider model metadata is a product/UX decision across multiple setup surfaces.

options.title: Accept after preservation fixes
options.body: Land this PR as the interactive custom-provider configure editor once it preserves modalities, API override semantics, and tiered pricing.

options.title: Fold into unified setup design
options.body: Pause this PR and design one model metadata setup surface across configure, onboard, and non-interactive custom-provider paths.

options.title: Defer to narrower context-window work
options.body: Keep only narrower context-window fixes such as the non-interactive flag path and close or replace this broader editor direction.

recommendation.title: Accept after preservation fixes
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the interactive custom-provider configure editor once it preserves modalities, API override semantics, and tiered pricing.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest recent history on custom-provider context defaults, image metadata setup, and provider picker behavior points to steipete for the cross-surface product decision.
